pcs.pc_description: Determine the routine maintenance requirements of various components and control system by interpreting manufacturer manual, maintenance checklist and schedule, work instructions, etc
Read maintenance schedule and checklist and plan the time and schedule for conducting the maintenance activities
Identify various systems, sub systems and control systems of the smart grid
Arrange tools, consumables, spare parts, etc. required for performing repair and maintenance
Clear the work area thoroughly to ensure no unwanted materials are present before starting the work
Ensure that devices, machines etc. in the smart grid are not connected to any power source before starting maintenance work
Adhere to all safety norms (such as wearing protective gloves and shoes, etc.) in accordance with the international/ national and organisational standards
Inform all affected parties of the intended work plan prior to disconnecting power supply line
Perform basic health check-up of instruments, sensors, controllers etc. as specified in the manufacturer manual
Start and shut down process of smart grid to observe the functioning of power plant and its systems under the supervision of supervisor/engineer
Check the technical and mechanical systems to ensure their operation within the specified parameters
Inspect power stations, transmission lines, distribution lines, automated systems and other critical equipment for identification of faults, possible wear and tear etc.
Locate the protection devices i.e. relay, breaker etc., conduit, cables & other underground system to perform maintenance work
Carry out the maintenance activities by following appropriate techniques and procedures
Monitor running parameter of smart grid and auxiliaries’ system as per design standard
Test the system parameters to know abnormal condition of the system and healthiness of connected equipment
Check the problem and keep the superiors informed about progress or any delays in resolving the problem
Upgrade or modify the existing unhealthy equipment/system after confirmation from supervisor/engineer
Suggest technical changes in equipment/system to supervisor/engineer
Suggest software upgradation and testing required to supervisor/engineer

modules.module_title: Troubleshooting and repairing of faulty equipment

pcs.pc_description: Carry out troubleshooting of faulty or unhealthy equipment to determine root causes and develop processes to avoid repeat failure
Identify the type of faults, required tools and devices for removal of faults

Conduct breakdown maintenance and then inspect the equipment for leaks, short circuit in parts, breakage of wires and clamps, vibrations, erratic/problematic performance or any other problem as reported in the complaint
Isolate the faulty part and replace/repair it by following correct procedures and manufacturer specification
Clean and tighten the terminals, screws, clamps and cables and ensure that they are free from dirt, grime and corrosion by following the instructions given in manufacturer manual
Conduct the appropriate tests related to the functional performance of equipment, as required
Coordinate with engineers and process technicians to resolve the issues requiring their assistance
Coordinate with the relevant personnel to evaluate the functioning of smart grid
Assess when the problem is beyond his competence and report the problem to suitably qualified/designated and competent personnel
Leave the work area in clean and tidy condition after the completion of work
Dispose off waste materials such as failed parts/aggregates, as per organisation’s and environmental policies
Record all repairs carried out, time taken and other significant findings observed during the work process
Ensure that all maintenance activities are adequately addressed

modules.module_title: Follow workplace health and safety practices

pcs.pc_description: use protective clothing/equipment for specific tasks and work conditions (Protective clothing: leather or asbestos gloves, flame proof aprons, flame proof overalls buttoned to neck, cuff less (without folds) trousers, reinforced footwear, helmets/hard hats, cap and shoulder covers, ear defenders/plugs, safety boots, knee pads, particle masks, glasses/goggles/visors) (Equipment: hand and face shields, machine guards, residual current devices, shields, dust sheets, respirator)

identify job-site hazards and possible causes of risks/accident at the workplace (Hazards: electrical hazards, sharp edged and heavy tools, heated metals, oxyfuel and gas cylinders, welding radiation, hazardous surfaces, hazardous substances, physical hazards. Possible causes of risk and accident: physical actions, not following instructions, inattention, sickness and incapacity, health, not taking safety precautions)
use standard safe working practices when working at heights, confined areas, trenches and with electrical equipment
follow warning signs and symbols while working with electrical systems (Warning signs: Danger plate, high voltage area, out of service, etc.)
ensure positive isolation of electrical equipment and system as per the given standards
identify any abnormalities in electrical equipment or system viz temperature, pressure, flow of current etc.

use various methods of accident prevention in the work environment (Methods of accident prevention: use of equipment and working practices, safety notices, advice, instruction from colleagues and supervisors)
use proper scaffolds, elevated platforms and ladders for working at height
inspect various tools and plants (T & P) routinely for any signs of oil, water leakages
store flammable materials and machine lubricating oil safely and correctly
check that the emission and pollution control devices are working properly in line with environmental policy standards
inform the relevant authorities about any abnormal situation/behavior of any equipment/system without delay
use various appropriate fire extinguishers for different types of fires correctly (Types of fires: Class A, B, C, D and E)
use appropriate rescue techniques during fire hazard
use good housekeeping practices at all times to avoid accidental fire
